title: V03: add the bounded prefix caller and refusal controls
body:

The 34,716-byte caller has SHA256 `25138c2c998762649c6a61cb8a6ae8aacd81bd533591b082ab6f58def712fca2`; the 14,236-byte fixture has SHA256 `310fe5a31db4c4ac2bab0794a1633ec2061e8f97de654f9701b019185b138765`.

The caller replaces only its old 9,574-byte support prefix with the accepted 9,878-byte prefix (`48bc4009…`), closing the copied-prefix short-I/O-cap gap. Every following byte equals the old90a tail. Exact original `source_packet` and `RootProxy` segments remain preserved. The old caller is inert comparison/gap evidence. Unit07 closed P1-P4 with conditional source-component PASS; exact P3 review `f61464ed7496af2ae47414bcdfad2f63e773563411c4e70a2fc8955442e7b089` is retained. The new preparer is a separate source export.

This is source preservation and finite replay, with a parameterized operation bill. It grants no full C05/full V03/runtime/current-T0/source/native/C07/funding/fit/enclosing-parent-exit admission, complete physical invoice, new κ, human review or proof-kernel acceptance. Original completion stays43.5%, activities22/49, stage2/10, milestones1/10, components24, helpers52, with zero original activity credit. Recorded guarded94.550533479/2400 is not the physical total; outside costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. The app goal remains separately paused.
